architecture_iteration.correction: retain the exact upstream displacement path; condition the direct P head on y_max/x_max and scale its output by E*u_delta/x_max
architecture_iteration.held_out_caveat: the baseline held-out aggregate was already observed and motivated iteration 2; the post-selection evaluation is confirmatory rather than a pristine first look
architecture_iteration.root_cause: the legacy direct P head was exactly invariant to uniform specimen scaling because upstream PI-GINOT normalizes x and y independently; fixed displacement therefore supplied no physical stress scale

selection.guardrails: >=10% primary-score improvement; dogbone P improves in both folds; paired centre P <= linear+0.02; worst mean u <= linear+0.005; worst peak <= linear+0.05

assumptions.centre_notched_plate: 50 mm fixed length, upper-right quarter of a smooth symmetric double-edge notch; notch_radius is root curvature radius
assumptions.failed_case_resolution: 20/10 split preassigned before solves; no outcome-dependent reshuffle; all held-out cases required for a complete report

commit_scope: base commit plus uncommitted local S1 worktree; S1 commit prohibited

peak_qoi.qoi_definition: Frobenius norm of in-plane first-Piola stress on the smooth root region; the dogbone loaded/free endpoint is masked
peak_qoi.reason: all three smooth-root samples stabilized below the declared 10% last-refinement threshold

peak_qoi.qoi_definition: Frobenius norm of in-plane first-Piola stress on the smooth root region; the dogbone loaded/free endpoint is masked
peak_qoi.reason: all three smooth-root samples stabilized below the declared 10% last-refinement threshold

lr_sweep.initialization: exact upstream best.pt encoder/displacement weights at epoch 1424; direct P head output layer initialized to zero
lr_sweep.loss_normalization: per-geometry RMS targets; equilibrium uses sqrt(x_max*y_max) as the fixed characteristic length
lr_sweep.selection_rule: minimum worst-family reference-area relative L2 P error on 8 geometries reserved only from the 40-geometry training split; held-out evaluation untouched

model.architecture_adaptation: exact vendored upstream PI_GINOT encoder and displacement decoder; a direct four-component first-Piola conditioned MLP head is added with y_max/x_max input and E*u_delta/x_max output scaling
known_legacy_limitations: the upstream hard-BC displacement correction is not multiplied by physical x/y scales, so the displacement path remains not dimensionally equivariant under uniform geometry scaling
the conditioned direct stress head is calibrated only for the fixed 1 mm S1 load and does not establish generalization to unseen loads
FEM nodal stresses use element-to-node count averaging, so the small-area peak-stress QoI remains recovery-sensitive
